entities.summary: Dadash Dadashbayli is an Azerbaijani weightlifter. He is the 2024 European champion, a silver medalist at the 2024 World Weightlifting Championships, a bronze medalist at the 2023 World Weightlifting Championships, and a gold medalist at the 2023 CIS Games.
